lessons.title: 2. Trimming & Replacing Text
lessons.description: `.strip()` removes whitespace from both ends. `.replace(old, new)` replaces substrings.
learning_objectives: Clean strings using strip() and replace()

tests.name: test_clean_and_censor
tests.unittest_code:
def test_clean_and_censor(self):
    self.assertEqual(clean_and_censor("  bad words  ", "bad", "***"), "*** words")

lessons.solution_code:
def clean_and_censor(s, word, mask):
    return s.strip().replace(word, mask)
